items.heading: Recruiters Read Many Resumes Quickly
items.text: Recruiters read many resumes quickly. These are the signals that decide whether yours is read further.

items.heading: Write One Short Line
items.text: Write one short line for each step, then merge them into two or three sentences. Cut every adjective that you cannot back with a fact.

items.heading: These Are Patterns, Not Scripts
items.text: These are patterns, not scripts. Replace every detail with your own real work, and never claim a result you did not produce.
